name: easybrandkit
description: easybrandkit: a website's real logo files, colors, fonts and first screen, saved as a brand kit your coding agent reads before it designs anything.

plugins.name: easybrandkit
plugins.description: Reads a product's website in a headless browser and saves its logos (cut on their real background), colors, fonts, first screen and app store images as brand.json and BRAND.md.
